`ifndef BP_COMMON_RV64_CSR_DEFINES_SVH
`define BP_COMMON_RV64_CSR_DEFINES_SVH

  `define PRIV_MODE_M            2'b11
  `define PRIV_MODE_S            2'b01
  `define PRIV_MODE_U            1'b0

  `define CSR_ADDR_USTATUS       12'h000

reset_low_priv_bits: PRIV_MODE_M=2'b11, priv_mode is last packed field; reset_image1666'd3
prior_image: existing lower-priority next-state expressions before restore override; abstracted as fully live1666bit input equally in both arms
valid_image_liveness: all1666bits exposed only through consumed/restored image, no raw invalid data output
boundary: exact restore selection/reset-priority envelope, not complete CSR engine. Post-restore ASID WARL masking at930 and CSR destination width masks are intentionally not used to prune any of the requested1666 live payload bits. No integrated CPU resource claim.
